o1: Enables GTPase activity and protein kinase binding activity. Involved in actin cytoskeleton organization; axon guidance; and engulfment of apoptotic cell. Acts upstream of or within embryonic body morphogenesis. Is located in cytoplasm; cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane; and neuron projection. Is expressed in distal tip cell; linker cell; neurons; somatic gonad precursor; and vulval cell. Is part of the let-502/mel-11 pathway. Used to study epilepsy. Orthologous to human RHOG (ras homolog family member G).
